newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor up on enquiries, drop in arrivals.
newsitem.headline: India castor up on enquiries, drop in arrivals.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery lifted to 1,155/1,156 rupees per quintal from 1,148 rupees on fresh speculative buying, dealers said on Tuesday.

Increased overseas enquiries and drop in the arrivals at producing centres prompted bull buying. The slow progress of the second round of the monsoon at producing centres also aided the firm tendency.
"Shippers are short and they are covering positions ahead of shipment," one operator said.
Groundnut oil moved up by 6/7 rupees at 376/377 rupees per 10 kg on limited supplies and upsurge in producing centres.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose by 5/10 rupees at 605/610 rupees per 15 kg on limited offerings by millers and stockists amid the slow monsoon progress.
In Bombay imported palm-oil slid to 258/259 rupees per 10 kg from 262/263 rupees on arrivals of about 5,000 tonnes at Bombay port coupled with losses in the world market.
